search.method: Seeded simulated annealing with balanced cross-group swaps, then deterministic steepest improving balanced swaps from baseline and annealing best

control.interface_matrix_convention: Each undirected edge is counted once in [min(group_a, group_b)][max(group_a, group_b)]; lower triangle is zero. Diagonal entries are within-group faces.

candidate.interface_matrix_convention: Each undirected edge is counted once in [min(group_a, group_b)][max(group_a, group_b)]; lower triangle is zero. Diagonal entries are within-group faces.

interpretation_limits: Groups are logical groups of existing rank IDs, not historical physical hosts; no original placement map was available.
The processor decomposition and processor directories remain unchanged; no runnable rank-order payload is emitted.
Boundary artifacts were not sealed at original submission, and full mesh and field identity were not established by this intake.
Interface-face cuts do not measure network bytes, MPI wait, solver critical path, locality, or speedup.
Cell totals are rank cell counts grouped under a hypothetical logical host mapping; no cell migration or solver balance was tested.
The seeded bounded heuristic is not an optimizer proof and can return a local or nonoptimal assignment.
